meta.title: Lingering Melody
meta.description: The first day of spring is upon us, even though the night of New Year's Eve has not yet ended.

units.rawText: After the New Year party is over.
units.displayText: After the New Year party is over.

spans.text: After the New Year party is over.

units.rawText: The Dolls who are still conscious leave the party hall in twos and threes, returning to their dorms.
units.displayText: The Dolls who are still conscious leave the party hall in twos and threes, returning to their dorms.

spans.text: The Dolls who are still conscious leave the party hall in twos and threes, returning to their dorms.

units.rawText: Quite a few Dolls are lost in the throes of an intoxicated state caused by high-intensity operands, and they end up falling asleep in a pile.
units.displayText: Quite a few Dolls are lost in the throes of an intoxicated state caused by high-intensity operands, and they end up falling asleep in a pile.

spans.text: Quite a few Dolls are lost in the throes of an intoxicated state caused by high-intensity operands, and they end up falling asleep in a pile.

units.rawText: Pro... Professor! I'm telling you, there really are Metal Suits flying in the sky. Look at that (hic) that light... that light over your head!
units.displayText: Pro... Professor! I'm telling you, there really are Metal Suits flying in the sky. Look at that (hic) that light... that light over your head!

spans.text: Pro... Professor! I'm telling you, there really are Metal Suits flying in the sky. Look at that (hic) that light... that light over your head!

units.rawText: ...Get a good rest, Croque.
units.displayText: ...Get a good rest, Croque.

spans.text: ...Get a good rest, Croque.

units.rawText: No, look at the light over your head, it's a Metal Suit's headlight, if you don't run you'll be (hic) you'll be squashed!
units.displayText: No, look at the light over your head, it's a Metal Suit's headlight, if you don't run you'll be (hic) you'll be squashed!

spans.text: No, look at the light over your head, it's a Metal Suit's headlight, if you don't run you'll be (hic) you'll be squashed!

units.rawText: ...Right, let's run first, and you run to your dorm from here.
units.displayText: ...Right, let's run first, and you run to your dorm from here.

spans.text: ...Right, let's run first, and you run to your dorm from here.

units.rawText: But I can't move...
units.displayText: But I can't move...

spans.text: But I can't move...

units.rawText: Prof, you take Croque and run... It's just a, a Metal Suit, watch me... I'm lifting it up!
units.displayText: Prof, you take Croque and run... It's just a, a Metal Suit, watch me... I'm lifting it up!

spans.text: Prof, you take Croque and run... It's just a, a Metal Suit, watch me... I'm lifting it up!

units.rawText: Don't you dare... look down on Metal Suits! Have a punch from yours truly!
units.displayText: Don't you dare... look down on Metal Suits! Have a punch from yours truly!

spans.text: Don't you dare... look down on Metal Suits! Have a punch from yours truly!

units.rawText: ...Why did I even try to reason with these drunkards...
units.displayText: ...Why did I even try to reason with these drunkards...

spans.text: ...Why did I even try to reason with these drunkards...

units.rawText: Just as I'm thinking that, I hear a voice.
units.displayText: Just as I'm thinking that, I hear a voice.

spans.text: Just as I'm thinking that, I hear a voice.

units.rawText: Hm? You haven't left yet, Professor?
units.displayText: Hm? You haven't left yet, Professor?

spans.text: Hm? You haven't left yet, Professor?

units.rawText: I turn back and see Daiyan standing in the doorway. Her cheeks are slightly flushed. It seems she's been somewhat affected by the operands as well.
units.displayText: I turn back and see Daiyan standing in the doorway. Her cheeks are slightly flushed. It seems she's been somewhat affected by the operands as well.

spans.text: I turn back and see Daiyan standing in the doorway. Her cheeks are slightly flushed. It seems she's been somewhat affected by the operands as well.

units.rawText: It's not convenient for Simo or Python to send them back to their dorms, so I am planning to send them back myself.
units.displayText: It's not convenient for Simo or Python to send them back to their dorms, so I am planning to send them back myself.

spans.text: It's not convenient for Simo or Python to send them back to their dorms, so I am planning to send them back myself.

units.rawText: Hehe, It seems Miss Croque is very averse to anyone entering her dorm, whether they appear male or female... You must be on her whitelist.
units.displayText: Hehe, It seems Miss Croque is very averse to anyone entering her dorm, whether they appear male or female... You must be on her whitelist.

spans.text: Hehe, It seems Miss Croque is very averse to anyone entering her dorm, whether they appear male or female... You must be on her whitelist.

units.rawText: I guess. Why did you come back?
units.displayText: I guess. Why did you come back?

spans.text: I guess. Why did you come back?

units.rawText: I thought... You were probably busy with the cleanup work, and I guess I was right. Isn't Miss Persicaria with you?
units.displayText: I thought... You were probably busy with the cleanup work, and I guess I was right. Isn't Miss Persicaria with you?

spans.text: I thought... You were probably busy with the cleanup work, and I guess I was right. Isn't Miss Persicaria with you?

units.rawText: She got drunk too. I just came back after bringing her back to her room.
units.displayText: She got drunk too. I just came back after bringing her back to her room.

spans.text: She got drunk too. I just came back after bringing her back to her room.

units.rawText: What a coincidence, I just brought Chanzhi and Souchun back.
units.displayText: What a coincidence, I just brought Chanzhi and Souchun back.

spans.text: What a coincidence, I just brought Chanzhi and Souchun back.

units.rawText: Looks like hard labor is our lot in life. Once I put them back in their rooms I'll be done. Just in time to send you back too, then?
units.displayText: Looks like hard labor is our lot in life. Once I put them back in their rooms I'll be done. Just in time to send you back too, then?

spans.text: Looks like hard labor is our lot in life. Once I put them back in their rooms I'll be done. Just in time to send you back too, then?

units.rawText: Daiyan chuckles.
units.displayText: Daiyan chuckles.

spans.text: Daiyan chuckles.

units.rawText: I shall impose on you, then.
units.displayText: I shall impose on you, then.

spans.text: I shall impose on you, then.

units.rawText: After I put the others safely in their rooms, I escort Daiyan back to her dorm.
units.displayText: After I put the others safely in their rooms, I escort Daiyan back to her dorm.

spans.text: After I put the others safely in their rooms, I escort Daiyan back to her dorm.

units.rawText: This is my room...
units.displayText: This is my room...

spans.text: This is my room...

units.rawText: Why is it so dark in here? You didn't leave the lights on?
units.displayText: Why is it so dark in here? You didn't leave the lights on?

spans.text: Why is it so dark in here? You didn't leave the lights on?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, where's the light switch... aiya?!
units.displayText: I'm sorry, where's the light switch... aiya?!

spans.text: I'm sorry, where's the light switch... aiya?!

units.rawText: I help Daiyan inside, but then I trip on something and we both fall to the ground together.
units.displayText: I help Daiyan inside, but then I trip on something and we both fall to the ground together.

spans.text: I help Daiyan inside, but then I trip on something and we both fall to the ground together.

units.rawText: Ow... Are you alright, Professor?
units.displayText: Ow... Are you alright, Professor?

spans.text: Ow... Are you alright, Professor?

units.rawText: I'm fine, but wait, where's the switch?
units.displayText: I'm fine, but wait, where's the switch?

spans.text: I'm fine, but wait, where's the switch?

units.rawText: It's the second one after entering... I heard something break, so please mind your feet...
units.displayText: It's the second one after entering... I heard something break, so please mind your feet...

spans.text: It's the second one after entering... I heard something break, so please mind your feet...

units.rawText: I feel around for the switch and turn on the light.
units.displayText: I feel around for the switch and turn on the light.

spans.text: I feel around for the switch and turn on the light.

units.rawText: You decorated your room with a festive theme too?
units.displayText: You decorated your room with a festive theme too?

spans.text: You decorated your room with a festive theme too?

units.rawText: I've been used to putting up a canopy inside my room for a long time now. Since there's no suitable silk for that at the moment, I went with red.
units.displayText: I've been used to putting up a canopy inside my room for a long time now. Since there's no suitable silk for that at the moment, I went with red.

spans.text: I've been used to putting up a canopy inside my room for a long time now. Since there's no suitable silk for that at the moment, I went with red.

units.rawText: I was hoping to show you the flowers, but it seems the flowerpot broke just now. What a shame.
units.displayText: I was hoping to show you the flowers, but it seems the flowerpot broke just now. What a shame.

spans.text: I was hoping to show you the flowers, but it seems the flowerpot broke just now. What a shame.

units.rawText: Daiyan indicates the broken pot by her side.
units.displayText: Daiyan indicates the broken pot by her side.

spans.text: Daiyan indicates the broken pot by her side.

units.rawText: We can fix that, no need to worry.
units.displayText: We can fix that, no need to worry.

spans.text: We can fix that, no need to worry.

units.rawText: There's no need. If it broke, then it's broken. Let it rest in pieces.
units.displayText: There's no need. If it broke, then it's broken. Let it rest in pieces.

spans.text: There's no need. If it broke, then it's broken. Let it rest in pieces.

units.rawText: She glances at the broken stems beside her, then leans against the desk and fans herself.
units.displayText: She glances at the broken stems beside her, then leans against the desk and fans herself.

spans.text: She glances at the broken stems beside her, then leans against the desk and fans herself.

units.rawText: Beautiful when in bloom, and also beautiful when they wither.
units.displayText: Beautiful when in bloom, and also beautiful when they wither.

spans.text: Beautiful when in bloom, and also beautiful when they wither.

units.rawText: Would you like to stay for a cup of tea, Professor? Souchun gave me a few leaves.
units.displayText: Would you like to stay for a cup of tea, Professor? Souchun gave me a few leaves.

spans.text: Would you like to stay for a cup of tea, Professor? Souchun gave me a few leaves.

units.rawText: It's late, though. Won't it disturb your rest?
units.displayText: It's late, though. Won't it disturb your rest?

spans.text: It's late, though. Won't it disturb your rest?

units.rawText: Think of it as a sobering drink, and as thanks for accompanying me.
units.displayText: Think of it as a sobering drink, and as thanks for accompanying me.

spans.text: Think of it as a sobering drink, and as thanks for accompanying me.

units.rawText: I'll be counting on you, then.
units.displayText: I'll be counting on you, then.

spans.text: I'll be counting on you, then.

units.rawText: She pours two cups of tea, and hands me one of them.
units.displayText: She pours two cups of tea, and hands me one of them.

spans.text: She pours two cups of tea, and hands me one of them.

units.rawText: You certainly are amiable... In the future, I'll be nagging you nonstop.
units.displayText: You certainly are amiable... In the future, I'll be nagging you nonstop.

spans.text: You certainly are amiable... In the future, I'll be nagging you nonstop.

units.rawText: So you're saying... You plan to stay in the Oasis?
units.displayText: So you're saying... You plan to stay in the Oasis?

spans.text: So you're saying... You plan to stay in the Oasis?

units.rawText: Why not? While it's hardly explicit, when it's between you and me, it feels as though we've met each other before.
units.displayText: Why not? While it's hardly explicit, when it's between you and me, it feels as though we've met each other before.

spans.text: Why not? While it's hardly explicit, when it's between you and me, it feels as though we've met each other before.

units.rawText: Even if we don't know each other now, I'm sure we'll have a chance to get to know each other in reality.
units.displayText: Even if we don't know each other now, I'm sure we'll have a chance to get to know each other in reality.

spans.text: Even if we don't know each other now, I'm sure we'll have a chance to get to know each other in reality.

options.rawText: Indeed, we'll meet each other again in reality.
options.displayText: Indeed, we'll meet each other again in reality.

spans.text: Indeed, we'll meet each other again in reality.

options.rawText: Indeed, this might be our first time meeting, but I feel like our fates are intertwined.
options.displayText: Indeed, this might be our first time meeting, but I feel like our fates are intertwined.

spans.text: Indeed, this might be our first time meeting, but I feel like our fates are intertwined.
Perhaps.

units.rawText: I knew that feeling of mine wasn't wrong... I believe it will be a lovely bit of fate.
units.displayText: I knew that feeling of mine wasn't wrong... I believe it will be a lovely bit of fate.

spans.text: I knew that feeling of mine wasn't wrong... I believe it will be a lovely bit of fate.

units.rawText: A chance encounter is also a fated meeting... no?
units.displayText: A chance encounter is also a fated meeting... no?

spans.text: A chance encounter is also a fated meeting... no?

units.rawText: Hehe, oh you...
units.displayText: Hehe, oh you...

spans.text: Hehe, oh you...

units.rawText: Apart from this fleeting, faraway bit of happenstance, I heard your name from the mouths of many other Dolls.
units.displayText: Apart from this fleeting, faraway bit of happenstance, I heard your name from the mouths of many other Dolls.

spans.text: Apart from this fleeting, faraway bit of happenstance, I heard your name from the mouths of many other Dolls.

units.rawText: You're a little different from the "Professor" I knew in the past. But even if one can't trust hearsay...
units.displayText: You're a little different from the "Professor" I knew in the past. But even if one can't trust hearsay...

spans.text: You're a little different from the "Professor" I knew in the past. But even if one can't trust hearsay...

units.rawText: I've managed to piece together a portrait of a trustworthy leader from everyone's words.
units.displayText: I've managed to piece together a portrait of a trustworthy leader from everyone's words.

spans.text: I've managed to piece together a portrait of a trustworthy leader from everyone's words.

units.rawText: Is there anything else?
units.displayText: Is there anything else?

spans.text: Is there anything else?

units.rawText: ...You really are a sharp one. Indeed, I have some selfish desires of my own.
units.displayText: ...You really are a sharp one. Indeed, I have some selfish desires of my own.

spans.text: ...You really are a sharp one. Indeed, I have some selfish desires of my own.

units.rawText: One of them is to find Jiangyu. In addition, I hope to find someone to whom I can give my heart.
units.displayText: One of them is to find Jiangyu. In addition, I hope to find someone to whom I can give my heart.

spans.text: One of them is to find Jiangyu. In addition, I hope to find someone to whom I can give my heart.

units.rawText: Not like those male Dolls from several days ago, or a performer like myself... But someone who can decipher the true meaning of my songs, and one who truly needs me to play the zither for them.
units.displayText: Not like those male Dolls from several days ago, or a performer like myself... But someone who can decipher the true meaning of my songs, and one who truly needs me to play the zither for them.

spans.text: Not like those male Dolls from several days ago, or a performer like myself... But someone who can decipher the true meaning of my songs, and one who truly needs me to play the zither for them.

units.rawText: And you chose me?
units.displayText: And you chose me?

spans.text: And you chose me?

units.rawText: Perhaps it could be you. The tea's finished. Would you like to hear another song?
units.displayText: Perhaps it could be you. The tea's finished. Would you like to hear another song?

spans.text: Perhaps it could be you. The tea's finished. Would you like to hear another song?
Of course.

options.rawText: Isn't it a little late tonight?
options.displayText: Isn't it a little late tonight?

spans.text: Isn't it a little late tonight?

units.rawText: Thank you. Then, allow me to transform the afterglow of this night into a melody and play you a piece...
units.displayText: Thank you. Then, allow me to transform the afterglow of this night into a melody and play you a piece...

spans.text: Thank you. Then, allow me to transform the afterglow of this night into a melody and play you a piece...

units.rawText: If it's you, you can always rest here.
units.displayText: If it's you, you can always rest here.

spans.text: If it's you, you can always rest here.

units.rawText: Daiyan seems exceptionally frank tonight.
units.displayText: Daiyan seems exceptionally frank tonight.

spans.text: Daiyan seems exceptionally frank tonight.

units.rawText: Is she drunk? Or has the night worn away the distance between us? I don't know, and pressing her for an answer would be too insensitive.
units.displayText: Is she drunk? Or has the night worn away the distance between us? I don't know, and pressing her for an answer would be too insensitive.

spans.text: Is she drunk? Or has the night worn away the distance between us? I don't know, and pressing her for an answer would be too insensitive.

units.rawText: As the guzheng plays, the lights quietly go out.
units.displayText: As the guzheng plays, the lights quietly go out.

spans.text: As the guzheng plays, the lights quietly go out.

units.rawText: The snapped branches fall amidst the petals covering the ground, and fade into the night.
units.displayText: The snapped branches fall amidst the petals covering the ground, and fade into the night.

spans.text: The snapped branches fall amidst the petals covering the ground, and fade into the night.
